Priya (CS): Heads-up team 
We need a tight QBR for AtlasWorks next Thu. Focus: onboarding gaps, renewal risk, and 3 exec asks. Claim slide ownership here.

Rina (RevOps): Ill add ARR numbers and a contingency scenario.

InfraBot: SSO rollout logs for AtlasWorks: https://ci.example.com/atlasworks/sso-2026-03-28

Priya (CS): Yes  Product asked to deliver a short self-help runbook. No ETA. Call it out in action register.

Priya (CS): Drop slides in the shared deck by Tue EOD: https://drive.example.com/atlasworks-qbr. Dry-run Wed 16:00 UTC. If you cant make it, send slides early.

Leo (CS): Will upload by Tue. Adding two customer quotes for health slide.

Diego (Sales): Ill sync with the sponsor Tue morning if Rina's contingency looks amber or red.
